sentences.text: Shri Vipin Singh Badharia - Advocate for applicant.
Ms.Samta Jain - Govt. Advocate for respondent/State.

Order 
This is first bail application filed on behalf of the applicant under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
2.

The applicant is in custody since 26.08.2024 in connection with Crime No.183/2024 registered at P.S.-Jabera, District-Damoh (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 366, 376,
376(2)(n) of IPC and Sections 3/4, 5/6 & 16 of POCSO.

3. Prosecution story, in brief, is that applicant repeatedly committed aggravated penetrative sexual assault on minor prosecutrix.
4.
Learned counsel for the applicant after referring to prosecutrix statement recorded under Section 183 of BNSS, submits that it is case of consensual relationship and parties have solemnized marriage.
It is prosecutrix's Bua, who asked prosecutrix to go along with applicant.
Applicant is in jail since 26.08.2024.
After investigation, charge sheet has been filed.
It is also urged that parties have lived together from 27.5.2024 to 25.08.2024.
The trial of the case will take considerable time.

Therefore, it has been prayed that the applicant be released on NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-JBP:5779 2 MCRC-4853-2025 bail pending the trial.

sentences.text: On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed grant of bail 6.
Having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Consequently, first bail application under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

7. It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.
He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
8. This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
9. Soft copy of this bail order immediately/forthwith be sent to applicant through concerned Jail Superintendent.
10. Certified copy as per rules.
